title: Enhancing Biologically Inspired Hierarchical Temporal Memory with Hardware-Accelerated Reflex Memory
core_idea: Introduce a reflex memory (RM) block, inspired by spinal cord mechanisms, to accelerate first-order temporal inferences within Hierarchical Temporal Memory (HTM). Integrating RM with HTM yields an accelerated HTM (AHTM) that handles repetitive, first-order relationships more efficiently while retaining multiorder inference capability; a hardware CAM implementation (H-AHTM) further accelerates RM processing to address sequence memory bottlenecks caused by extensive programmable interconnects in large-scale IoT data settings.
tldr: Add a spinal-cord-inspired reflex memory block (and a hardware CAM implementation) to HTM to speed up first-order sequence inferences for more efficient unsupervised processing of repetitive IoT data while maintaining multiorder support.
